LanguageData.RM_Bones_ButcherBones_Tip: Butchering a fleshy, non-insect body also yields bones (its bone amount x the multiplier below x the butcher's efficiency). Off: no bones from butchering; bones still come from a rotting bed and stay a building material.
LanguageData.RM_Bones_Multiplier_Tip: Scales every butchering bone yield. 1 is the shipped amount; 0 yields none.
